//: SKERRICK, AN IMP (docs/PLAN_demons.md D1; game/demon.h). The demon a book in the Harrowby smithy cellar names. His NAME is the glyph `summon_skerrick` (assets/spells/glyphs.json); his BODY is the mob def `imp_skerrick` (assets/mobs/demon/, generated by assets/editor/demon.js's `imp` preset: knee-high, hunched, horned, clawed, tailed, eyes lit sulfur); his MANNER is the behaviors.json profile `imp` (faction demon, hostile, quick claws and bites).
name: Skerrick
//released: The behaviour profile he takes when you let him out of the circle and the binding HOLDS (D3: strength >= power + contract weight). A placeholder for D5's contract: neutral -- he wants nobody until struck. If the binding does not hold he is loose under `behavior` instead.
//dialogue: The conversation while he is contained (D5; assets/dialogue/<name>.json): T within 8 m of him opens it. Its nodes may say {tell} (a line from tells.json for the current margin), {name}, {margin}, {weight}, {contract}.
//tier: 1 = an imp: weak, few tricks, simply leaves when a contract ends (D5/D6). Greater demons are 2..3.
//power: Weighed against a circle's strength plus a contract's weight (D3/D5): binding holds iff strength >= power + weight. Low: a plain salt ring and a stock contract hold an imp.
//gaze: hold | avert: whether the summoner must meet his eyes or look away while he is in the circle (D3's strain meter).
//resist: Per channel, against a seal pile's potency (D3: a channel is severed iff potency >= resistance). `move` is the salt loop itself. There is no touch channel (D6): salt always stops his claws at the ring.
//ironSusceptibility: D6: iron in the band takes potency x this / 100 off his power while he is contained (seals.json weakenCapPct caps it). A 3x3+1 iron pile (potency 10) -> 6: power 20-6.
//motive: D6 (game/demon_malice.h): 0..100 each. malice -- how much hurting you is worth to him; cunning -- how much more the indirect way is worth (and which schemes he thinks of: schemes.json minCunning); spite -- how much being hurt sharpens the malice; literalism -- how readily he counts a duty's loophole as doing it. A petty imp: he will not claw you for nothing (claw 15 < comply 40), he will put lava under you if nothing forbids it (57), and he will claw you happily if that gets him sent home.
//schemes: The tricks he knows (D6's assets/demons/schemes.json): an imp knows few -- the ground under you, a lift and a drop, a gust at his own ring while he is in it -- and his claws.
